company.name: Eze
company.shortDescription: Eze is a B2B marketplace for electronics allowing buyers and sellers to trade in wholesale quantities with real-time market data.
company.description: Eze is a B2B Marketplace that connects telecommunication and global electronic wholesalers allowing them to trade devices in wholesale quantities with real-time market data. It aims to formalize the fragmented and inefficient second-hand electronics market that had an estimated beachhead of $46 billion.

productsAndServices.description: A B2B marketplace for buying and selling new, used, and refurbished electronics in wholesale quantities, including smartphones, laptops, tablets, accessories, gaming consoles, and other consumer devices.
productsAndServices.name: Eze Wholesale Electronics Marketplace

productsAndServices.description: A wholesale purchasing feature that lets buyers submit offers for electronics at specified prices and purchase devices at available asking prices.
productsAndServices.name: Eze Bidding

productsAndServices.description: A data and dashboard service providing real-time and historical market information, sales tracking, growth metrics, and trends in top-selling electronics models.
productsAndServices.name: Wholesale Electronics Market Data and Business Dashboard

productsAndServices.description: A device evaluation service that tests, sanitizes, data-wipes, and assigns condition grades to new, used, and refurbished electronics offered on the marketplace.
productsAndServices.name: Device Grading and Inspection

productsAndServices.description: A platform service for verified sellers to apply, publish electronics inventory, fulfill buyer requests, ship devices for inspection, and receive payment after successful delivery.
productsAndServices.name: Seller Enablement and Wholesale Fulfillment

productsAndServices.description: A transaction service that coordinates payment processing, warehouse inspection, order fulfillment, and tracked domestic or international delivery for wholesale electronics orders.
productsAndServices.name: Wholesale Order Processing, Payments, and Shipping

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $3,700,000, or 89.16% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,610,418 to $22,122,044, a 3.94x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 28 (-38 over 90 days) and market heat at 61 (+4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
